512-3043-4644.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-3043-4644.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-3043-4644.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4871-6798-8168.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1170-2921-3375-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-3375-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

654-1308-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

188-3713-7839.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale using the ability granted to it by Lavamancer's Skill by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

454-1651-2709-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

2073-6797-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1409-3099-4289-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2034-4013-7294.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Hellspur Posse Boss.
When Hellspur Posse Boss enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1818-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
1818-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

2113-3525-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7606.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2539-3094-4460-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4460-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1256-5499-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5499-7175.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1409-5420-6751.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2691-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.

3110-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

232-1235-2493-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Archaeomancer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2921-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

5220-5231-5849.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5849.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
5220-5231-5849.notes: If Fortune Teller's Talent is level 3, the nontoken creature could have a maximum mana value of 4, so long as the creature's mana cost before reductions is at most {2}{R}.

4186-5256-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
4186-5256-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1462-4125-6801.easyPrerequisites:
You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
Permanents you control that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{W}.
1462-4125-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-4125-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

1251-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-3334-3574-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Mikaeus.
2060-3334-3574-4222.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3334-3574-4222.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

77-4050-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

2034-2403-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

101-957-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

1987-3821-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-5913.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake.
When Pinnacle Monk and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-5913.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2308-2440-2999.manaNeeded: {2}, plus an additional {1} available if you do not control a Fungus or Beast
2308-2440-2999.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2308-2440-2999.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Fungus and/or Beast you control.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

396-2034-4013-4772.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-5153-5251.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire and Emmara do not have summoning sickness.
1636-5153-5251.description:
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, tapping Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

112-971-2020.notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has a power of three or greater.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
112-971-2020.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}, putting a charge counter on Pentad Prism and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1020-4659-5129.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
When Myr Retriever enters, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning an artifact card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Myr Retriever.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr Retriever token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Myr Retriever token dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2479-5200.easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Magus of the Coffers.
2479-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Coffers does not have summoning sickness.
At least six Swamps under your control.
2479-5200.description:
Pay {2} to activate Magus of the Coffers, adding at least six {B}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns, untapping Magus of the Coffers (floating {2}).
Repeatedly tap the Magus for mana and untap it, generating at least {B} per iteration.
